title: util.symbol() interferes with @util.deprecated decorator

labels.name: use case
labels.description: not really a feature or a bug; can be support for new DB features or user use cases not anticipated

body:
**Describe the bug**
Adding an `@util.deprecated` decorator as shown at

https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/2060/3/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/schema.py#872

causes pytest to crash with 

``` text

```

**Expected behavior**
No crash.

**Error**
Using pdb I found that the issue is related to `schema=RETAIN_SCHEMA` in the arguments list for the `tometadata` function, where RETAIN_SCHEMA is

``` python
RETAIN_SCHEMA = util.symbol("retain_schema")
```

When pdb kicks in we can see that

``` text
> <string>(1)<module>()
(Pdb) u
> c:\users\gord\git\sqla-gerrit\lib\sqlalchemy\util\langhelpers.py(171)_exec_code_in_env()
-> exec(code, env)
(Pdb) code
"def tometadata(self, metadata, schema=symbol('retain_schema'), referred_schema_fn=None, name=None):\n    return target(fn, self, metadata, schema=schema, referred_schema_fn=referred_schema_fn, name=name)\n"
(Pdb)
```

**Versions.**
 - OS: Windows 8.1
 - Python: 3.7.5 x64
 - SQLAlchemy: https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/2060
 - Database: mssql
 - DBAPI: pyodbc
